CONSORT.en: Trial reports must follow the CONSORT statement to support transparent assessment of methods.
CONSORT.zh: 试验报告必须遵循 CONSORT 声明，以支持对研究方法的透明评估。

CONSORT.en: Reviewers asked authors to submit a CONSORT flow diagram alongside the trial registry identifier.
CONSORT.zh: 审稿人要求作者在投稿时附上 CONSORT 流程图与试验注册标识。

CONSORT.en: Journal editors cited CONSORT as the basis for checking whether outcome definitions were reported consistently.
CONSORT.zh: 期刊编辑以 CONSORT 为依据，核查各结局指标的定义是否报告得一致。

STROBE.en: Cohort papers should follow the STROBE statement when describing participant selection and outcome measures.
STROBE.zh: 队列研究论文在描述受试者选择与结局指标时应遵循 STROBE 声明。

STROBE.en: The STROBE checklist helped reviewers locate biases in the retrospective analysis of hospital records.
STROBE.zh: STROBE 清单帮助审稿人发现了该回顾性病历分析中的偏倚。

STROBE.en: Authors explained how their cohort design met each STROBE item that applied to observational research.
STROBE.zh: 作者说明其队列设计如何满足适用于观察性研究的每一项 STROBE 条目。

standard error.en: The reported standard error grew as the sample size within each subgroup declined.
standard error.zh: 各亚组样本量下降时，报告的标准误随之增大。

standard error.en: Confidence intervals were derived from the standard error of the estimated mean difference.
standard error.zh: 置信区间由均值差估计值的标准误推得。

standard error.en: Rounding the standard error upward made the reported effect appear less precise than it was.
standard error.zh: 将标准误向上取整会使所报告效应的精确度显得低于实际水平。

covariance.en: Covariance between the two markers was positive, indicating that their concentrations tended to move together.
covariance.zh: 两种标志物之间的协方差为正，表明其浓度往往同向变化。

covariance.en: Ignoring covariance between the variables distorted the estimated variance of their sum.
covariance.zh: 忽略变量间的协方差会使其总和的估计方差失真。

covariance.en: Positive covariance between rainfall and yields indicates that the two variables tend to move together.
covariance.zh: 降雨与产量之间的正协方差表明，这两个变量往往同向变化。

heteroskedasticity.en: Heteroskedasticity in the residuals invalidates the usual standard errors of the regression coefficients.
heteroskedasticity.zh: 残差中的异方差性使得回归系数的常规标准误失效。

heteroskedasticity.en: Heteroskedasticity-robust estimators were reported because the variance of the errors differed across groups.
heteroskedasticity.zh: 由于误差方差在不同组间确有差异，研究报告了异方差稳健估计量。

heteroskedasticity.en: Plots of squared residuals against fitted values helped diagnose heteroskedasticity before any formal test.
heteroskedasticity.zh: 以平方残差对拟合值作图，可在任何正式检验之前诊断异方差性。

autocorrelation.en: Autocorrelation in the residual series inflated the apparent precision of the estimated trend.
autocorrelation.zh: 残差序列中的自相关夸大了所估计趋势的表观精确度。

autocorrelation.en: Positive autocorrelation in annual rainfall implies that wet years tend to follow wet years.
autocorrelation.zh: 年降水量的正自相关意味着多雨年份往往接续出现。

autocorrelation.en: The model was refitted with an autocorrelation term to account for dependence among successive observations.
autocorrelation.zh: 模型重新拟合并加入自相关项，以处理相继观测之间的依赖性。

missing data.en: Missing data were handled with multiple imputation rather than by deleting incomplete cases.
missing data.zh: 数据缺失采用多重插补处理，而非直接删除不完整个案。

missing data.en: A sensitivity analysis examined how strongly the missing data mechanism had to depend on unobserved values to change the conclusions.
missing data.zh: 一项敏感性分析考察了数据缺失机制须在多大程度上依赖未观测值，才会改变结论。

missing data.en: Reporting the amount of missing data for each variable is now expected by most journals.
missing data.zh: 报告各变量的数据缺失量如今已成为多数期刊的要求。

bootstrap.en: We bootstrap the standard error of the estimated effect to obtain a bias-corrected interval.
bootstrap.zh: 我们以自助法重抽样估计效应量的标准误，从而得到偏差校正区间。

bootstrap.en: Researchers bootstrap the sampling distribution when the analytical form of the estimator is unknown.
bootstrap.zh: 当估计量的解析形式未知时，研究者以自助法重抽样获得抽样分布。

bootstrap.en: Bootstrapping the model-selection procedure revealed how unstable the ranking of models was.
bootstrap.zh: 对模型选择过程进行自助抽样，揭示了模型排序的不稳定性。

permutation.en: A permutation test provides an exact p value when the sampling distribution cannot be derived analytically.
permutation.zh: 当抽样分布无法解析导出时，置换检验可给出精确的 p 值。

permutation.en: Permutation of the group labels was repeated many times to build a null distribution.
permutation.zh: 通过对组别标签进行置换并多次重复，构建了零分布。

permutation.en: The permutation scheme preserves the exchangeability assumption that the test relies upon.
permutation.zh: 该置换方案保留了检验所依赖的可交换性假设。

degrees of freedom.en: Reducing the number of covariates gives the regression more degrees of freedom.
degrees of freedom.zh: 减少协变量数量可为回归模型提供更多自由度。

degrees of freedom.en: The reported standard error was adjusted for the degrees of freedom lost by the restriction.
degrees of freedom.zh: 报告的标准误已就因约束而损失的自由度作了调整。

degrees of freedom.en: Simulation results depended strongly on the degrees of freedom assumed for each variance component.
degrees of freedom.zh: 模拟结果显著依赖于为各方差成分所假定的自由度。

chi-square.en: A chi-square test of independence revealed no significant association between treatment group and recovery time.
chi-square.zh: 独立性卡方检验显示治疗组别与恢复时间之间无显著关联。

chi-square.en: The chi-square statistic was unreliable because several cells contained very few observations.
chi-square.zh: 由于若干单元格观测数极少，卡方统计量并不可靠。

chi-square.en: Expected counts must be checked before a chi-square approximation is trusted for sparse tables.
chi-square.zh: 在稀疏表中依赖卡方近似之前，必须先检验期望频数。

Monte Carlo.en: A Monte Carlo simulation was used to check whether the estimator was biased under a heavy-tailed distribution.
Monte Carlo.zh: 研究采用蒙特卡洛模拟检验估计量在重尾分布下是否有偏。

Monte Carlo.en: The Monte Carlo error decreased as the number of simulated replications grew.
Monte Carlo.zh: 随着模拟重复次数增加，蒙特卡洛误差随之减小。

Monte Carlo.en: Monte Carlo integration gave stable estimates of the expected value for the model.
Monte Carlo.zh: 蒙特卡洛积分为该模型的期望值给出了稳定的估计。

median.en: The median of the response times was lower than the mean because a few observations were extremely large.
median.zh: 响应时间的中位数低于均值，因为少数观测值极大。

median.en: Report the median together with the interquartile range when the distribution is skewed.
median.zh: 当分布偏斜时，应将中位数与四分位距一并报告。

median.en: A median regression was preferred to least squares because the residuals showed several outliers.
median.zh: 由于残差中存在若干离群值，研究采用中位数回归而非最小二乘。

quartile.en: The lower quartile of response times was under two seconds, indicating that at least a quarter of patients responded quickly.
quartile.zh: 反应时间的下四分位数低于两秒，表明至少四分之一的患者反应迅速。

quartile.en: Values above the upper quartile were inspected for recording errors before analysis continued.
quartile.zh: 分析继续之前，研究核查了高于上四分位数的数值以排除记录错误。

quartile.en: Each quartile of the sample received a different level of the intervention.
quartile.zh: 样本的每个四分位组接受了不同强度的干预。

percentile.en: The ninetieth percentile of waiting time was reported to describe the burden on the service.
percentile.zh: 报告等待时间的第九十百分位数，用以刻画服务负担。

percentile.en: Percentile curves by age group allow readers to locate an individual's position within the distribution.
percentile.zh: 按年龄组绘制的百分位曲线便于读者确定个体在分布中的位置。

percentile.en: A percentile bootstrap interval was preferred over the normal approximation for skewed outcomes.
percentile.zh: 对偏斜结局，研究偏好采用百分位自助法区间而非正态近似。

recall.en: Recall measures the proportion of actual positive cases that the classifier correctly identifies.
recall.zh: 召回率衡量全部实际阳性个案中被分类器正确识别者所占的比例。

recall.en: A low recall for the minority class led the team to reweight the training examples.
recall.zh: 少数类别的召回率偏低，促使团队对训练样本重新赋权。

recall.en: Precision and recall were reported together because either metric alone can be misleading.
recall.zh: 精确率与召回率一并报告，因为单看任一指标都可能产生误导。

confusion matrix.en: The confusion matrix for the diagnostic classifier was computed on an independent holdout sample.
confusion matrix.zh: 该诊断分类器的混淆矩阵是在独立留出样本上计算的。

confusion matrix.en: Rows of the confusion matrix represent actual classes while columns represent predicted labels.
confusion matrix.zh: 混淆矩阵的行表示实际类别，列表示预测标签。

confusion matrix.en: Reading a confusion matrix showed that most of the errors fell into one particular cell.
confusion matrix.zh: 阅读混淆矩阵可见，多数错误集中于某一个单元格。

ground truth.en: The annotation team compared its labels with the ground truth produced by expert pathologists.
ground truth.zh: 标注团队将其标签与专家病理医师给出的真值进行了比较。

ground truth.en: Any evaluation of a classifier against ground truth is affected by errors in that reference labeling.
ground truth.zh: 任何依据真值开展的分类器评估都会受到参考标注错误的影响。

ground truth.en: Establishing ground truth for the historical photographs required lengthy correspondence with archives.
ground truth.zh: 为这些历史照片确立真值，需要与档案馆长期通信。

overfitting.en: Repeated model selection on the same data risks overfitting to the quirks of that sample.
overfitting.zh: 在同一数据上反复进行模型选择，会有对样本特征过拟合的风险。

overfitting.en: Cross-validation was introduced to detect overfitting before the model was deployed.
overfitting.zh: 在模型部署之前引入交叉验证，用以检测过拟合。

overfitting.en: The gap between training and test performance suggested mild overfitting in the deeper architecture.
overfitting.zh: 训练表现与测试表现之间的差距提示较深的网络存在轻度过拟合。

regularization.en: Ridge regularization shrinks the coefficients and reduces the variance of the fitted model.
regularization.zh: 岭回归的正则化收缩系数并降低拟合模型的方差。

regularization.en: Regularization strength was chosen by nested cross-validation to avoid optimistic performance estimates.
regularization.zh: 正则化强度通过嵌套交叉验证选定，以避免乐观的性能估计。

regularization.en: The penalty term acts as regularization and discourages the model from fitting noise.
regularization.zh: 该惩罚项起到正则化作用，抑制模型去拟合噪声。

annotation.en: Two coders worked independently on the annotation of each transcript before comparing their decisions.
annotation.zh: 两名编码者先独立完成每份转录稿的标注，再比较各自的判断。

annotation.en: Annotation guidelines were revised after the pilot study exposed inconsistent labeling of emotion.
annotation.zh: 预研究暴露出情感标注不一致后，标注指南作了修订。

annotation.en: The annotation interface let reviewers attach free-text comments to each coded segment.
annotation.zh: 标注界面允许审阅者为每个已编码片段添加自由文本批注。

coding.en: Open coding was applied to the interview transcripts before any thematic categories were defined.
coding.zh: 在界定任何主题类别之前，先对访谈转录稿进行开放式编码。

coding.en: Axial coding then linked the initial codes into broader categories that shaped the final framework.
coding.zh: 主轴编码随后把初始编码联结为更宽泛的类别，从而塑造了最终框架。

coding.en: The coding process proceeded in two passes, and the team documented each decision in the audit trail.
coding.zh: 编码过程分两轮进行，团队将每一项决定都记录在审计轨迹之中。
